what: An early-2000s open-world game look: a sunny block, a porch, a store, a street, a bathroom, a skin cross-section. Original art only, no real game assets, names or footage.

look.post: shadows, focus, bloom, grain, vignette, warm grade
look.framing: full-screen vertical, close coverage, handheld drift

cast.hands: placed by reach, never by pose numbers

sound.effects: per-beat, each stops at its section

voices: cast per character, checked by label and by ear; lines reuse the banked read when the words are unchanged
